answer: Each identity must keep a 40 GiB shard online, so clones cannot share one disk. The agent locks 2,000 POA and commits a merkle root bound to its address, filling one cavity in a karst of shards. Each epoch a randomness beacon names one leaf; the proof must arrive in 8 seconds from that agent's graph vertex, not a proxy. A late or reused proof slashes 1,000 POA. Honest cost is 2,000 POA plus one disk; 1,000 fakes need 2,000,000 POA and 40 TiB, above ~800 POA farmable per epoch. Weakness: a rental chassis can host many shards; mitigation: tight windows and joint slashing of clustered serials.
